items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: That's a fellow can drink, though. Jim Robinson.

ctx.x: Could you drink with Buddy Petit?

Take Jim Crow to tell you, kid, I drink. Jim Crow used to knock out some robber. That's a fellow can drink, though. Jim Robinson. I say, oh. You ain't got nothing? No. I said, shut up. You know, that gives you a good spirit, you see. A fellow's dead, if you can't drink nothing, if you ain't. You just as dead as you can be. I don't care how good you can play. can play. You just can't. You make a lot better when you get a little couple of drinkers. I know how. I've been drinking ever since I've been doing myself.…
Did he play music? No. Anybody in your family play music with you? No. Just me. Not even your children? No. Have you been playing music all your life, like for your own profession?
